title: Repeat browser commands with Enter
content:
Browser play

  • For easier travel, enable Settings → Display → Keep command after sending. Your command stays selected so Enter or Send repeats it, and typing replaces it. The preference is saved in your browser for your MUD account.
  • Press Escape to clear a retained command before using blank Enter to continue a page. Commands still clear after sending by default. Echo Commands has its own setting for showing typed commands in the game output.
